entities.label: Users

fields.expression: CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END
fields.default: CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END

entities.sql:
USE RecruitPlatform_Target;

TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.[User];

INSERT INTO dbo.[User] (
    UserID,
    Loginname,
    FullName,
    Email,
    Role,
    Status,
    IsDeleted,
    IsArchived
)
SELECT
    u.user_id                                                    AS UserID,
    LEFT(u.email, CHARINDEX('@', u.email + '@') - 1)             AS Loginname,
    CONCAT_WS(' ', u.first_name, u.last_name)                    AS FullName,
    u.email                                                      AS Email,
    u.role                                                       AS Role,
    CASE WHEN u.is_active = 1 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END  AS Status,
    0                                                            AS IsDeleted,
    0                                                            AS IsArchived
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Users u;

entities.sql:
USE RecruitPlatform_Target;

TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.Contact;

DELETE FROM dbo.MigrationRejects WHERE target_table = N'Contact';

INSERT INTO dbo.MigrationRejects (target_table, source_key, action, reason)
SELECT N'Contact', CAST(ct.contact_id AS NVARCHAR(200)), N'rejected', N'contact linked to no company (orphan)'
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Contacts ct
WHERE NOT (ct.client_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Clients x WHERE x.client_id = ct.client_id));

INSERT INTO dbo.Contact (
    ID,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    CompanyID,
    Email,
    Phone,
    PositionTitle,
    Contacttype,
    ContactOwnerID,
    IsDeleted,
    IsArchived,
    AddedBy,
    AddedAt
)
SELECT
    ct.contact_id                                       AS ID,
    ct.first_name                                       AS FirstName,
    ct.last_name                                        AS LastName,
    ct.client_id                                        AS CompanyID,
    ct.email                                            AS Email,
    COALESCE(ct.phone, ct.mobile)                       AS Phone,
    LEFT(ct.job_title, 50)                              AS PositionTitle,
    'Client contact'                                    AS Contacttype,
    ct.owner_user_id                                    AS ContactOwnerID,
    0                                                   AS IsDeleted,
    CASE WHEN ct.status = 'inactive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS IsArchived,
    ct.owner_user_id                                    AS AddedBy,
    ct.created_at                                       AS AddedAt
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Contacts ct
WHERE (ct.client_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Clients x WHERE x.client_id = ct.client_id));

entities.sql:
USE RecruitPlatform_Target;

TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.Position;

DELETE FROM dbo.MigrationRejects WHERE target_table = N'Position';

INSERT INTO dbo.MigrationRejects (target_table, source_key, action, reason)
SELECT N'Position', CAST(TRY_CAST(j.job_id AS INT) AS NVARCHAR(200)), N'flagged', N'open job on a deleted company'
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs j
WHERE NOT (j.status NOT IN ('open', 'interviewing', 'offer made') OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Clients x WHERE x.client_id = j.client_id AND x.status = 'deleted'));

INSERT INTO dbo.Position (
    ID,
    PositionName,
    CompanyID,
    ContactID,
    Status,
    Filled,
    Closed,
    Deleted,
    PositionChargeRate,
    Salary,
    Currency,
    DateBegins,
    DateEnds,
    Addedby,
    PositionOwnerID
)
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(j.job_id AS INT)                                        AS ID,
    LEFT(j.title, 50)                                                AS PositionName,
    j.client_id                                                      AS CompanyID,
    j.contact_id                                                     AS ContactID,
    j.status                                                         AS Status,
    CASE WHEN j.status = 'filled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                  AS Filled,
    CASE WHEN j.status IN ('filled', 'cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS Closed,
    CASE WHEN j.status = 'deleted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                 AS Deleted,
    j.rate                                                           AS PositionChargeRate,
    CAST(j.salary_min AS NVARCHAR(50))                               AS Salary,
    'GBP'                                                            AS Currency,
    j.opened_at                                                      AS DateBegins,
    j.closed_at                                                      AS DateEnds,
    j.owner_user_id                                                  AS Addedby,
    j.owner_user_id                                                  AS PositionOwnerID
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs j;

entities.label: Placements
entities.sql:
USE RecruitPlatform_Target;

TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.Placements;

DELETE FROM dbo.MigrationRejects WHERE target_table = N'Placements';

INSERT INTO dbo.MigrationRejects (target_table, source_key, action, reason)
SELECT N'Placements', CAST(TRY_CAST(pl.placement_id AS INT) AS NVARCHAR(200)), N'rejected', N'not a migrated candidate (a contact, a removed duplicate or missing)'
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Placements pl
LEFT JOIN Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs j ON j.job_id = pl.job_id
WHERE NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Candidates x WHERE x.candidate_id = pl.candidate_id));

INSERT INTO dbo.MigrationRejects (target_table, source_key, action, reason)
SELECT N'Placements', CAST(TRY_CAST(pl.placement_id AS INT) AS NVARCHAR(200)), N'flagged', N'live placement on a deleted job'
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Placements pl
LEFT JOIN Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs j ON j.job_id = pl.job_id
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Candidates x WHERE x.candidate_id = pl.candidate_id))
  AND NOT (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs x WHERE x.job_id = pl.job_id AND x.status = 'deleted'));

INSERT INTO dbo.MigrationRejects (target_table, source_key, action, reason)
SELECT N'Placements', CAST(TRY_CAST(pl.placement_id AS INT) AS NVARCHAR(200)), N'flagged', N'live placement on a deleted company'
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Placements pl
LEFT JOIN Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs j ON j.job_id = pl.job_id
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Candidates x WHERE x.candidate_id = pl.candidate_id))
  AND NOT (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Clients x WHERE x.client_id = j.client_id AND x.status = 'deleted'));

INSERT INTO dbo.Placements (
    ID,
    ApplicantID,
    PositionID,
    CompanyID,
    EmploymentType,
    StartDate,
    EndDate,
    Fee,
    Status,
    OwnerID
)
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(pl.placement_id AS INT)  AS ID,
    pl.candidate_id                   AS ApplicantID,
    TRY_CAST(pl.job_id AS INT)        AS PositionID,
    j.client_id                       AS CompanyID,
    pl.placement_type                 AS EmploymentType,
    pl.start_date                     AS StartDate,
    pl.end_date                       AS EndDate,
    pl.fee                            AS Fee,
    'Placed'                          AS Status,
    pl.owner_user_id                  AS OwnerID
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Placements pl
LEFT JOIN Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs j ON j.job_id = pl.job_id
WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Candidates x WHERE x.candidate_id = pl.candidate_id));

entities.sql:
USE RecruitPlatform_Target;

TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.Notes;

DELETE FROM dbo.MigrationRejects WHERE target_table = N'Notes';

INSERT INTO dbo.MigrationRejects (target_table, source_key, action, reason)
SELECT N'Notes', CAST(TRY_CAST(n.note_id AS INT) AS NVARCHAR(200)), N'rejected', N'linked to no migrated record (orphan)'
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Notes n
WHERE NOT ((n.entity_type = 'candidate' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Candidates x WHERE x.candidate_id = n.entity_id)) OR (n.entity_type = 'contact' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Contacts x WHERE x.contact_id = n.entity_id AND x.client_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (n.entity_type = 'job' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs x WHERE x.job_id = n.entity_id)) OR (n.entity_type = 'client' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Clients x WHERE x.client_id = n.entity_id)));

INSERT INTO dbo.Notes (
    ID,
    Text,
    ApplicantID,
    CompanyID,
    PositionID,
    ContactID,
    Deleted,
    AddedAt,
    UserID
)
SELECT
    TRY_CAST(n.note_id AS INT)                                             AS ID,
    n.body                                                                 AS Text,
    CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'candidate' THEN n.entity_id END             AS ApplicantID,
    CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'client' THEN n.entity_id END                AS CompanyID,
    CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'job' THEN TRY_CAST(n.entity_id AS INT) END  AS PositionID,
    CASE WHEN n.entity_type = 'contact' THEN n.entity_id END               AS ContactID,
    0                                                                      AS Deleted,
    n.created_at                                                           AS AddedAt,
    n.author_user_id                                                       AS UserID
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Notes n
WHERE ((n.entity_type = 'candidate' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Candidates x WHERE x.candidate_id = n.entity_id)) OR (n.entity_type = 'contact' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Contacts x WHERE x.contact_id = n.entity_id AND x.client_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (n.entity_type = 'job' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs x WHERE x.job_id = n.entity_id)) OR (n.entity_type = 'client' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Clients x WHERE x.client_id = n.entity_id)));

fields.default: CASE WHEN d.document_id LIKE 'CV%' THEN 100000 + TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 3, 20) AS INT) ELSE TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 2, 20) AS INT) END

entities.sql:
USE RecruitPlatform_Target;

TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.Attachments;

DELETE FROM dbo.MigrationRejects WHERE target_table = N'Attachments';

INSERT INTO dbo.MigrationRejects (target_table, source_key, action, reason)
SELECT N'Attachments', CAST(CASE WHEN d.document_id LIKE 'CV%' THEN 100000 + TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 3, 20) AS INT) ELSE TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 2, 20) AS INT) END AS NVARCHAR(200)), N'rejected', N'linked to no migrated record (orphan)'
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Documents d
WHERE NOT ((d.entity_type = 'candidate' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Candidates x WHERE x.candidate_id = d.entity_id)) OR (d.entity_type = 'contact' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Contacts x WHERE x.contact_id = d.entity_id AND x.client_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (d.entity_type = 'job' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs x WHERE x.job_id = d.entity_id)) OR (d.entity_type = 'client' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Clients x WHERE x.client_id = d.entity_id)));

INSERT INTO dbo.Attachments (
    AttachmentID,
    AttachmentType,
    AttachmentName,
    FilePath,
    FileType,
    UploadedAt,
    IsPrimary,
    IsArchived,
    IsDeleted
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN d.document_id LIKE 'CV%' THEN 100000 + TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 3, 20) AS INT) ELSE TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 2, 20) AS INT) END  AS AttachmentID,
    d.entity_type                                                                                                                                                AS AttachmentType,
    LEFT(d.file_name, 50)                                                                                                                                        AS AttachmentName,
    LEFT(d.storage_path, 50)                                                                                                                                     AS FilePath,
    d.file_type                                                                                                                                                  AS FileType,
    d.uploaded_at                                                                                                                                                AS UploadedAt,
    0                                                                                                                                                            AS IsPrimary,
    0                                                                                                                                                            AS IsArchived,
    0                                                                                                                                                            AS IsDeleted
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Documents d
WHERE ((d.entity_type = 'candidate' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Candidates x WHERE x.candidate_id = d.entity_id)) OR (d.entity_type = 'contact' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Contacts x WHERE x.contact_id = d.entity_id AND x.client_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (d.entity_type = 'job' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs x WHERE x.job_id = d.entity_id)) OR (d.entity_type = 'client' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Clients x WHERE x.client_id = d.entity_id)));

DELETE FROM dbo.MigrationRejects WHERE target_table = N'PositionAttachment';

INSERT INTO dbo.MigrationRejects (target_table, source_key, action, reason)
SELECT N'PositionAttachment', CAST(CASE WHEN d.document_id LIKE 'CV%' THEN 100000 + TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 3, 20) AS INT) ELSE TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 2, 20) AS INT) END AS NVARCHAR(200)), N'rejected', N'linked to no migrated record (orphan)'
FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Documents d
WHERE (d.entity_type = 'job')
  AND NOT ((d.entity_type = 'candidate' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Candidates x WHERE x.candidate_id = d.entity_id)) OR (d.entity_type = 'contact' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Contacts x WHERE x.contact_id = d.entity_id AND x.client_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (d.entity_type = 'job' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Jobs x WHERE x.job_id = d.entity_id)) OR (d.entity_type = 'client' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Migration_Staging.mid.Clients x WHERE x.client_id = d.entity_id)));

    CASE WHEN d.document_id LIKE 'CV%' THEN 100000 + TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 3, 20) AS INT) ELSE TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(d.document_id, 2, 20) AS INT) END  AS AttachmentID,
    TRY_CAST(d.entity_id AS INT)                                                                                                                                 AS PositionID,
